name: alpha kinase 1
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: ALPK1 encodes alpha-protein kinase 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and cilium assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to retinal dystrophy, optic nerve edema, splenomegaly, anhidrosis, and migraine headache syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Spiradenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
